responsibility: Provides the NetBSD-specific rs6000 subtarget header for PowerPC ELF targets. It overrides the generic SysV4-derived preprocessing and driver specs to match NetBSD conventions, defines the PowerPC and endianness builtins/asserts expected by NetBSD headers, fixes ABI-visible C type macros like size_t and ptrdiff_t to agree with the system headers, selects NetBSD start/end files and libraries, and enables standard DWARF register numbering for debugging.
